answer: The karst index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the kernel queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 222 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the marble. A 317 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
